name: decision
title: rosync decision
description: Shows or answers the pending initial sync decision without opening the widget UI.
notes: Without a choice flag, prints the current pending initial sync decision.
When exactly one decision is pending, `--choice-id` can be omitted.
`--disk` keeps local files and pushes them to Studio; `--studio` keeps Studio and pulls it to disk; `--cancel` aborts the initial sync.
